intent_summary: Sample evidence distinguishes reference-only, provisional, and calibrated comparisons before permitting statistical point triggers.

criteria.criterion: Short series return reference evidence and an insufficient_history status instead of inventing calibrated findings.
criteria.notes: The short-series test checks three reference-only samples, absent standardized scores, and no triggers.

criteria.criterion: Provisional residual scores can be reported but do not trigger point-anomaly episodes.
criteria.notes: A provisional score of 2 exceeds the configured point threshold of 1 but produces no trigger or episode.

criteria.criterion: Completed calibration provides a frozen residual center and sample scale for later standardized residuals.
criteria.notes: Calibration uses retained residual mean and sample standard deviation once per regime; the independent numerical example produces the expected standardized score.

criteria.criterion: Evidence records the observed value, expectation, calibration support, and numerical criterion responsible for a trigger.
criteria.notes: Sample fields retain the comparison and support; the point threshold is inspectable in the enclosing method parameters.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
